content.text: The [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/digital-product-payment-solutions-west-africa-what-actually-3|Digital Product]] product economy is structurally unfair to creators in restricted markets. The tools that Western creators take for granted — Stripe for [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/tron-usdt-payments-digital-products-every-detail-you-4|payments]], Gumroad for storefront and delivery, PayPal for international transfers — are either unavailable or functionally broken for creators in Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Zimbabwe, and dozens of other markets. The answer is not finding a better platform. The answer is removing the platform layer entirely. A sovereign digital commerce stack gives you a storefront you host, a payment processor that runs on blockchain rails, and an [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-explained-digital-creators-5|COREMERCH guide to automated]] delivery system that sends your product within 30 seconds of payment confirmation. You collect revenue directly into a wallet you control. You convert to local currency through P2P exchanges at near-market rates. The platform cannot suspend you because you are not on any platform.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-explained-digital-creators-5. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Solana payment

The Solana payment solution for digital products is a game-changer for creators who have been locked out by traditional payment platforms. By leveraging Solana's blockchain technology, creators can now sell their digital products, such as ebooks, courses, and templates, without relying on intermediaries like Stripe or PayPal. This approach not only reduces transaction fees but also ensures that creators have full control over their sales and customer data.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture of the Solana payment solution is built around a combination of free and paid tools, including GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, and Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage. NOWPayments, a crypto payment gateway, is integrated to enable automatic on-chain payment verification, with a minimal fee of 0.5%. This infrastructure stack provides a robust and scalable solution for digital creators to sell their products online.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is specifically designed for digital creators in regions where traditional payment platforms are unavailable or severely restricted. By using Solana payments, creators can now reach a global audience and sell their digital products without being limited by geographical constraints. The low transaction fees and full control over sales and customer data make this solution an attractive option for creators who want to maintain their independence and sovereignty over their online businesses.
Solana payments reduce transaction fees by up to 95% compared to traditional payment platforms.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The key components of the Solana payment solution include the hosting platform, backend logic, order storage, and crypto payment gateway. Each of these components works together seamlessly to provide a streamlined and efficient sales process. For example, when a customer makes a purchase, the payment is verified on-chain by NOWPayments, and the digital product is delivered automatically via Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. This integrated approach ensures that the sales process is secure, reliable, and hassle-free.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy the Solana payment solution today, digital creators can start by choosing a hosting platform and setting up their store using a pre-built template. They can then integrate NOWPayments and configure their backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. With the Complete Builder Kit ($197), creators can access all the necessary blueprints and templates to build, deploy, and scale their sovereign digital commerce stack. This comprehensive solution provides everything needed to get started and succeed in the digital marketplace.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, creators can use the Solana payment solution, which provides a secure and efficient way to process transactions. By leveraging blockchain technology and a crypto payment gateway like NOWPayments, creators can maintain full control over their sales and customer data, while also reducing transaction fees. For example, at 100 sales per month on a $97 product, the fee difference between Gumroad's 10% fee and NOWPayments' 0.5% fee retains $921.

To deploy the Solana payment solution, follow these steps: Choose a hosting platform like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, set up your store using a pre-built template, integrate NOWPayments for crypto payment processing, configure your backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, and test your store to ensure a smooth sales process. By following these steps, creators can quickly and easily establish a secure and efficient online sales process. The transaction fee for Solana payments is 0.5%, which is significantly lower than the fees charged by traditional payment platforms like Gumroad.

No, buyers do not need to have an account to use Solana payments, making it a convenient and accessible option for digital creators.
